title: And there was Colonel Everard down there in Cavan growing tobacco
html_source: Colonel Nugent Everard was a grower of tobacco in Navan, County Meath. Joyce handwritten manuscripts show this as Navan, it’s possible that it was wrongly transcribed to Cavan, which is in the northern part of Ireland.
